# WIKA TRANSLATE SUDAN

WIKA TRANSLATE SUDAN is Sudan's leading professional translation and interpretation company, headquartered at Al Emtidad Street, Omdurman, Sudan. We provide certified translation, simultaneous interpretation, consecutive interpretation, legal translation, document translation, and interpretation equipment rental in Arabic, English, French and 100+ languages. We serve UN agencies, international NGOs, embassies, government ministries, development banks, and international organizations across Sudan and the Horn of Africa.

## Services

- [Document Translation Sudan](https://www.wikatranslate.us/services/document-translation-sudan): Professional translation of reports, proposals, surveys, and technical documents in 100+ languages.
- [Certified Translation Sudan](https://www.wikatranslate.us/services/certified-translation-sudan): Signed certified translations accepted by Sudanese courts, government ministries, and embassies, including MINIJUST notarization assistance.
- [Interpretation Services Sudan](https://www.wikatranslate.us/services/interpretation-services-sudan): Simultaneous, consecutive, and remote interpretation for conferences, UN meetings, and negotiations.
- [Interpretation Equipment Rental Sudan](https://www.wikatranslate.us/services/interpretation-equipment-rental-sudan): Soundproof booths, wireless receivers, microphones, and technical support.
